subject.title: [Bug]: Memory Multimodal Indexing - Gemini API rejects OGG/Opus audio files

question: Should Gemini multimodal memory keep advertising OGG/Opus support by adding an owned transcode path, or should it narrow/skip unsupported Gemini audio formats with diagnostics and docs?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but the permanent behavior changes user-visible format support and may add a new media conversion dependency and operational surface.

options.title: Narrow Gemini audio support
options.body: Limit raw Gemini audio indexing to MP3/WAV, skip or fail unsupported audio with clear diagnostics, and update docs to match the provider contract.

options.title: Own audio transcoding
options.body: Keep OGG/Opus in the advertised formats by adding a tested transcode-to-WAV/MP3 path with dependency checks and live Gemini proof.

recommendation.title: Narrow Gemini audio support
recommendation.body: Limit raw Gemini audio indexing to MP3/WAV, skip or fail unsupported audio with clear diagnostics, and update docs to match the provider contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and merged the multimodal memory audio indexing path that now needs the product-boundary choice.
